details.description: Neural2 is a text-to-speech voice type offered by Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, built, per Google's documentation, on "the same technology used to create a Custom Voice," giving custom-voice-level naturalness without training and submitting a customer's own recordings. As of Google's current supported-voices table it spans 17 languages and locales — English (US, UK, Australian, and Indian), French (France and Canadian), Spanish (Spain and US), German, Danish, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazilian), Hindi, Thai, and Vietnamese — with between 1 and 9 voices per locale. Google's current voice-type documentation does not mark Neural2 as deprecated or legacy.
advantages: Built on the same neural technology Google uses to create a Custom Voice, giving custom-voice-level naturalness without training a bespoke voice model, per Google's documentation.
Covers 17 languages and locales, including English, French, Spanish, German, Danish, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Hindi, Thai, and Vietnamese, per Google's current supported-voices table.
US English alone offers 9 distinct Neural2 voices and UK English 7, spanning multiple male and female options, per Google's voice list.
use_cases: Natural-sounding narration and IVR or voice-assistant prompts in a supported language without training a custom voice model.
Multilingual applications needing English, French, or Spanish locale variants, plus German, Danish, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Hindi, Thai, or Vietnamese, within one TTS tier.
Applications wanting a choice among several male and female voices per locale, such as the nine US English Neural2 voices.

sources.title: Supported voices and languages | Cloud Text-to-Speech

notes: Corrected the language list against Google's current supported-voices table (last updated 2026-09-18): Neural2 currently covers 17 locales, not 19. Filipino, Russian, Swedish, Turkish, Mandarin/Taiwanese Chinese, and European Portuguese have no Neural2 voices on the live table (though several have Standard/WaveNet voices), so they were removed; Spanish (Spain), Spanish (US), Hindi, and Thai do have Neural2 voices and were added. US English voice count corrected from 8 to 9, UK English from 6 to 7. Catalog facts give no max-token or deprecation values for this TTS model, consistent with what was found.
